headline: Trade Marketing Officer

experience.title: Trade Marketing Officer
bullets: Plan trade programs for sari-sari stores, groceries and resorts across Aurora and Nueva Ecija.
Designed a buy-ten-get-one promo for store owners that lifted case sales by 22% in the lean season.
Visit stores with the sales team to check displays, pricing and competitor activity.
Negotiate display space and shelf positions with grocery owners.

experience.title: Sales Merchandiser
bullets: Set up displays and maintained stock in 30 supermarkets and groceries.
Reported product and competitor information to the area sales manager every week.

summary: Trade marketing officer with four years in beverage and snack distribution. I design channel programs and store promotions, run store surveys and work side by side with the sales team to turn plans into sell-out. I know the sari-sari store and provincial grocery trade well.
skills: Product knowledge of beverages and snacks

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Marketing
